items.title: HDFC Sky launches SKY Direct bank-linked funding for HDFC Bank customers
items.body: SKY Direct holds funds in the customer's HDFC Bank savings account as trading limits; only the amount used for executed trades moves to the broker at day end. It covers cash, F&O, MTF and stock SIPs, and enables DDPI automatically for those without it.

items.title: SEBI weighs terminal safeguards and size-based rules for brokers
items.body: Proposals include tying trading terminals to MAC and static IP addresses to stop misuse, and compliance duties that scale with a broker’s size and reliance on technology. These are not final rules and no dates have been set.

items.title: SEBI waives margin on repeat cash trades after early pay-in
items.body: A SEBI circular dated 22 October says clearing corporations will not collect margin on a client's later cash-segment trades, up to the early pay-in value accepted (lower of EPI done or shares sold). Clients can reuse sale proceeds the same day; reversing the sale removes the benefit.

items.title: Groww opens US stock trading to all users
items.body: After a three-week pilot, every Groww user can buy over 10,000 US stocks and ETFs, including fractional shares. Brokerage is 0.1% of trade value; currency-conversion and bank fees are extra.

items.title: Zerodha opens US stock investing on Kite
items.body: Eligible resident individuals can buy about 2,000 US companies and 1,000 ETFs from $1. Brokerage is 0.1% capped at $10 an order plus GST, with a 0.5% currency markup. Runs through India INX Global Access at GIFT City.

items.title: Angel One adds US shares and ETFs, brokerage-free until December
items.body: US investing through GIFT City is rolling out in the app to selected users first, with full availability expected by mid-November. Brokerage is waived until December 2026; regulatory charges still apply.

items.title: Expiry settlement moves off the closing auction from 7 December
items.body: Expiring stock derivatives will settle at each stock’s volume-weighted average price over the last 30 minutes of trading. Index contracts settle on index values built the same way. The closing auction still sets the cash close.

items.title: Upstox sets 0.25% brokerage on physically settled stock F&O
items.body: Stock F&O positions left open into physical settlement are charged 0.25% of the settled value. Netted-off positions pay 0.1%, plus exchange charges.

items.title: Angel One Q2 profit rises 58% to ₹335 crore as users reach 4 crore
items.body: Consolidated profit for July-September was ₹335 crore on gross revenue of ₹1,431.5 crore (up 18.9%). Operating margin was 45.1%, the user base hit 4 crore, and its share of retail equity turnover was 19.7%.

items.title: Angel One closes in on Zerodha for the No. 2 spot
items.body: September NSE active clients: Groww 1.34 crore (29.16% share), Zerodha 67.92 lakh (down 5,313), Angel One 67.56 lakh (up 36,956). Upstox fell 10,343 to 18.54 lakh.

items.title: Dhan crosses 11.2 lakh active clients
items.body: Dhan added 13,624 active clients in September, the third-highest net addition among the top 10 brokers, and held 8th place on NSE. It was the twelfth straight month of growth.

items.title: Kotak Securities renames its retail business Kotak Neo
items.body: Kotak Securities Ltd stays the legal entity and existing accounts are unchanged. The brand now spans trading, investing and wealth, including a Private Client Group and Connect Plus for distributors.

items.title: 0.02% UPI fee on payments to brokers starts 15 October
items.body: UPI payments to brokers and mutual funds carry a 0.02% merchant fee capped at ₹300 (plus GST), paid by the broker. Reuters reports Zerodha and others are weighing new client charges or mandate-based payments to offset it.

items.title: Brokers must show SEBI investor-awareness messages from 1 November
items.body: The messages and risk disclosures go on every broker’s website landing page from 1 November 2026, and on app landing pages on alternate days.

items.title: ₹40 per intraday F&O order for some Zerodha accounts
items.body: Accounts that do not meet the 50% cash-margin requirement pay ₹40 instead of ₹20 per intraday F&O order. Equity delivery stays free.

items.title: F&O STT hike takes effect
items.body: STT on futures rose from 0.02% to 0.05% of sell value, and on options from 0.10% to 0.15% of premium. STT on exercised options went from 0.125% to 0.15%.
